ab-900.title: Study guide for Exam AB-900 – Microsoft Learn
ab-900.notes: AB-900 is an exam on Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent administration at fundamentals level, and the study guide explains what the exam covers and where to prepare. The audience is expected to know Microsoft 365 core services, security, identity and access, data protection and governance, and to be familiar with the admin centers for Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra and Purview. The skills are split into three areas: core features and objects of Microsoft 365 services, data protection and governance for Microsoft 365 and Copilot, and basic administration of Copilot and agents. Topics include licensing, Conditional Access, Purview capabilities such as DLP and Information Protection, oversharing in SharePoint, Researcher and Analyst, custom agents, and agent approval and monitoring in the admin centers. The pass mark is 700. The page lists no formal prerequisites and no required licenses for taking the exam. It also gives no question count, duration or fee. The certification expires after a year and is renewed through a free online assessment on Microsoft Learn.

ab-730.title: Exam AB-730: AI Business Professional – Microsoft Learn
ab-730.notes: The AI Business Professional certification targets people who use generative AI productivity tools and core Microsoft 365 apps to improve business results and decisions. No coding or app development is required. The exam measures understanding of generative AI basics, managing prompts and conversations, and creating and analyzing business content with AI. The page names Microsoft 365 Copilot, Researcher and Analyst as tools in scope. Candidates are expected to know Microsoft 365 and to be comfortable with Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint and Excel, including tasks like writing emails, building presentations, generating images and managing documents. The exam lasts 45 minutes, is proctored with interactive parts, and is offered in English only through Pearson VUE, with the price depending on the country. A failed attempt can be repeated after 24 hours. Microsoft recommends registering with a personal Microsoft account rather than a work account. The page does not state licensing needs, a passing score or how long the credential stays valid.

ab-731.title: Study guide for Exam AB-731: AI Transformation Leader – Microsoft Learn
ab-731.notes: AB-731 is aimed at business decision makers who guide transformation and innovation in teams or organizations, and no coding is expected. The study guide splits the exam into three areas. One covers the business value of generative AI, including prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, data quality and security. A second covers Microsoft AI apps and services such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Researcher and Analyst, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI Search and Microsoft Foundry. The third covers implementation and adoption, including responsible AI principles, an AI council, an adoption team, an AI champions program and licensing models like pay-as-you-go and subscription-included. Candidates should have experience with adoption or change management and know Microsoft 365 services. The page lists no formal prerequisites or exam fee, and the pass mark is 700. The certification expires yearly and is renewed through a free online assessment. Most questions address generally available features, though common preview features can appear.

ab-210.title: Exam AB-210: Dynamics 365 Sales AI Consultant Associate – Microsoft Learn
ab-210.notes: This associate-level certification covers designing and implementing AI-assisted sales solutions in Dynamics 365 Sales that support seller workflows from lead to cash. Typical roles are business analyst and functional consultant. Candidates configure Dynamics 365 Sales, Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales and agent capabilities, turning business needs into workflows that use conversational intelligence, predictive insights, guided automation and secure data access. The exam topics include configuring core Sales features for AI, optimizing AI-driven sales, qualifying and prioritizing leads, developing deals through intelligent opportunity research, and extending Sales. Candidates must know how to interpret sales processes, build and extend model-driven apps and create Power Automate cloud flows, and intermediate Power Platform configuration training is highly recommended. The exam is a beta that runs 120 minutes, is proctored, has a passing score of 700 and is delivered via Pearson VUE in several languages. Beta results are not scored immediately. The page names no license requirements and no certificate validity period.

ab-410.title: Microsoft Certified: Intelligent Applications Builder Associate – Microsoft Learn
ab-410.notes: This intermediate certification for developers confirms the ability to design, build and deliver AI-enabled solutions on Microsoft Power Platform using Copilot, low-code tools and built-in data features. It relates to Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages. The target profile builds Dataverse data models, model-driven and canvas apps, and cloud flows with business logic, and adds agents and Copilot features to apps and Power Pages sites. Candidates work alongside administrators, governance teams, agent developers, solution architects and business stakeholders. Expected experience includes natural-language creation of solution components, Dataverse modeling, Power Fx and low-code automation, plus knowledge of environment governance, roles, policies and the solution lifecycle. The exam AB-410 takes 120 minutes, is proctored and covers three areas: laying the foundation for intelligent applications, creating intelligent applications, and building business logic and automation. It is booked through Pearson VUE. The page gives no passing score, validity period or license requirements.

ab-620.title: Study guide for Exam AB-620: Designing and Building Integrated AI Agent Solutions in Copilot Studio – Microsoft Learn
ab-620.notes: AB-620 is the exam behind the AI Agent Builder Associate certification and focuses on building custom agents for enterprise solutions in Copilot Studio. The audience is professional developers or advanced builders, such as application developers, consultants and ISV partners. The skills fall into three areas: planning and configuring agent solutions, integrating and extending agents in Copilot Studio, and testing and managing agents. Topics include identity, channels, responsible AI, agent flows, topics, adaptive cards, connectors, MCP tools, REST APIs, multi-agent solutions, Foundry agents and the A2A protocol, as well as test sets, evaluation and application lifecycle management with solutions and pipelines. Candidates should know Power Fx, Dataverse and Power Platform and have intermediate generative AI knowledge, including RAG. The pass mark is 700. The certification expires yearly and renews through a free online assessment. The page gives no exam duration, question count, cost or Copilot Studio license requirements.

ai-103.title: Study guide for Exam AI-103: Developing AI Apps and Agents on Azure – Microsoft Learn
ai-103.notes: AI-103 is an exam for Azure AI engineers who build, manage and deploy agents and AI solutions on Microsoft Foundry, and the page describes it as leading to the Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate certification. Candidates are expected to have Python app development experience and basic knowledge of AI, generative AI and Azure services. The exam is divided into five areas: planning and managing an Azure AI solution, implementing generative AI and agentic solutions, computer vision, text analysis, and information extraction. Examples include model selection, deployment, monitoring, managed identity, RAG, tool calling, multi-agent solutions, tracing, image generation, speech input and output, semantic and vector search, and document extraction. The pass mark is 700. The certification expires after a year and is renewed with a free online assessment. A practice assessment and exam sandbox exist. The page lists no formal prerequisites, price, duration or Azure subscription requirements.

ai-200.title: Study guide for Exam AI-200: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure – Microsoft Learn
ai-200.notes: AI-200 targets people who implement AI solutions on Azure with an emphasis on back-end services and components, supporting design, development, deployment, security and monitoring. Expected skills include working with SDKs, data management services, messaging and eventing, vector databases, Python and containerized applications. The exam covers four areas: developing containerized solutions with Container Registry, App Service, Container Apps and AKS; building AI solutions with Cosmos DB for NoSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL with pgvector and Azure Managed Redis; connecting services through Service Bus, Event Grid and Functions; and securing, monitoring and troubleshooting with Key Vault, App Configuration, OpenTelemetry and KQL. The pass mark is 700. Most questions address generally available features. The certification expires after a year and is renewed through a free online assessment. The page names no formal prerequisites, cost, duration or question format, and related topics beyond the bullet points may be tested.

ai-300.title: Exam AI-300: Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate – Microsoft Learn
ai-300.notes: This intermediate certification, aimed at the AI engineer role, covers setting up infrastructure for machine learning operations and generative AI operations on Azure, together called AI operations. It is tied to Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry. The exam measures five areas: designing and implementing MLOps infrastructure, implementing the machine learning model lifecycle and operations, designing and implementing GenAIOps infrastructure, quality assurance and observability for generative AI, and optimizing GenAI systems and model performance. Candidates are expected to have experience with Azure Machine Learning and Foundry, a data science background, Python, basic DevOps knowledge such as GitHub Actions and command-line tools, and infrastructure as code with Bicep and the Azure CLI. The exam lasts 120 minutes, is proctored and offered in English through Pearson VUE. A failed attempt can be retried after 24 hours. The credential expires unless renewed, and renewal is a free online assessment. The page names no formal prerequisite, license details or pass mark.

ai-901.title: Exam AI-901: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals – Microsoft Learn
ai-901.notes: AI-901 is the exam for the Azure AI Fundamentals certification and is meant for candidates early in their AI solution development career. It covers AI workloads and considerations, basic machine learning principles on Azure, and the characteristics of computer vision, natural language processing and generative AI workloads. The skills are weighted in two groups: identifying AI concepts and capabilities, and implementing AI solutions with Microsoft Foundry. Candidates should have conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure, basic technical skills, Python syntax knowledge and familiarity with Azure resources. Knowledge of REST APIs, SDKs and command-line tools is expected. The pass mark is 700, and most questions address generally available features. The exam is available in many languages and can be booked through Pearson VUE or Certiport, with the price depending on the country. The page notes no retirement date. Preparation options include the course Introduction to AI in Azure, a study guide, an exam sandbox and a practice assessment. The page does not state duration or question count.

sc-500.title: Study guide for Exam SC-500: Implementing End-to-End Security Controls for Cloud and AI Workloads – Microsoft Learn
sc-500.notes: SC-500 is the exam for the Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate certification and targets security engineers who protect systems and data in cloud and hybrid environments, including identities, networks, applications, data and compute used by AI workloads. Core tasks include securing resource access with Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Key Vault, enforcing security and compliance requirements, securing storage, databases, networking and compute, securing AI solutions, and managing and monitoring security posture. The exam has four areas: managing identity, access and governance; securing storage, databases and networking; securing compute, including AI, virtual machines, containers and application platforms; and managing and monitoring security posture with tools such as Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel and Security Copilot. Candidates should have hands-on experience administering Azure and hybrid environments, strong Entra ID knowledge and basic Microsoft 365 administration knowledge. The pass mark is 700. The page names no formal prerequisites, license duties, fee, duration or question count.

az-802.title: Exam AZ-802: Administering Windows Server – Microsoft Learn
az-802.notes: AZ-802 is an exam within the Windows Server Administrator Associate certification, and the page itself says little about the certification beyond that. The exam is meant to validate skills in deploying, implementing, managing and troubleshooting Windows Server workloads in on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. Its areas are deploying and managing AD DS, managing Windows Server instances and workloads in hybrid settings, managing virtual machines, implementing on-premises and hybrid networking, managing storage and file services, securing the Windows Server infrastructure, and monitoring and troubleshooting. Recommended experience covers Windows Admin Center, Hyper-V, PowerShell, Azure Arc, Azure Monitor, Azure Update Manager, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and AD DS basics. The exam is available in English, is booked through Pearson VUE, and the price depends on the country. A course called Administer Windows Server supports preparation. The page lists no formal prerequisites, license requirements, validity period or renewal rules, and states no retirement date.

az-800.title: Exam AZ-800: Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure – Microsoft Learn
az-800.notes: AZ-800 is one of the exams for the Windows Server Administrator Associate certification and concerns administering Windows Server in on-premises and hybrid environments. The role covers deploying, managing and troubleshooting Windows Server, including in Azure, migrating workloads, and handling identity, security, compute, networking, storage and monitoring. Measured areas are AD DS in on-premises and cloud settings, hybrid server and workload management, virtual machines and containers, on-premises and hybrid networking, and storage and file services. Named tools include Windows Admin Center, PowerShell, Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Azure Update Manager and the Defender products. Several years of Windows Server experience is recommended, and the pass mark is 700. The related exam is AZ-801, which covers advanced services. A warning on the page says the exam was retired on 30 September 2026, after which it can no longer be taken for the certification, although the scheduling section still shows no retirement date. The page names no license requirements or price.

az-801.title: Exam AZ-801: Configuring Windows Server Hybrid Advanced Services – Microsoft Learn
az-801.notes: AZ-801 belongs to the Windows Server Administrator Associate certification and covers advanced services for administering Windows Server in on-premises and hybrid infrastructures, including migration to Azure. The measured areas are securing Windows Server, implementing and managing high availability, implementing disaster recovery, migrating servers and workloads, and monitoring and troubleshooting Windows Server environments. Named tools include Windows Admin Center, PowerShell, Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Azure Update Manager and the Defender products. Several years of Windows Server experience is recommended, and the pass mark is 700. The page lists no formal prerequisites; AZ-800 appears only as a related exam. A free practice assessment, a study guide and an exam sandbox are available. According to a warning on the page, the exam was retired on 30 September 2026, after which the certification can no longer be earned or renewed through it, though the scheduling section still reads no retirement date. Duration, question count, format and certificate validity are not given.

mb-240.title: Exam MB-240: Dynamics 365 Field Service Functional Consultant Associate – Microsoft Learn
mb-240.notes: MB-240 is the exam for the Dynamics 365 Field Service Functional Consultant Associate certification. The target person implements solutions that schedule resources, optimize them by skills, location and availability, equip frontline workers, and build a service history of customer assets. Exam areas are configuring Field Service applications, managing work orders and customer assets, scheduling resources and dispatching work orders, managing the mobile app, managing inventory and purchasing with the built-in inventory system, and implementing Microsoft Power Platform. Tasks include setting up agreements and booking settings, handling incident types and bookings, installing the mobile app and extending Field Service to customer needs. Candidates should understand Field Service principles, the work order lifecycle, integrations with Power Platform, Customer Service, Remote Assist and Guides, and how Copilot can be used in Field Service. A notice on the page says the exam is retired, although the scheduling section still shows no retirement date. The page names no license requirements, pass mark or duration.

mb-280.title: Exam MB-280: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst Associate – Microsoft Learn
mb-280.notes: This intermediate associate certification is for the Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst, who configures, customizes and extends Dynamics 365 Sales to support, automate and speed up a company's sales process. Typical roles are business analyst and functional consultant. Candidates should understand sales processes and the seller's view, AI features that raise sales efficiency, and end-to-end marketing features that support sales. They configure standard and premium Sales features, set up collaboration tools, manage the security model, customize the app, extend it with Microsoft Power Platform and support sales with Customer Insights - Journeys. The exam areas are implementing Dynamics 365 Sales, configuring and customizing Dataverse and model-driven apps, demonstrating Customer Insights capabilities, and extending Sales. Recommended background includes Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate cloud flows and Customer Insights. The exam is proctored and offered in several languages. A warning states that the certification and its renewal exam are retired. The page lists no formal prerequisites, license requirements, price or validity.

mb-335.title: Exam MB-335: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Expert – Microsoft Learn
mb-335.notes: MB-335 is the required exam for the Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Expert certification. Candidates design solutions and configure Supply Chain Management for complex customer requirements, using advanced process knowledge and industry practices. They analyze requirements, map them to system functions, spot dependencies between processes and work with solution architects, developers, consultants, users and project managers. The exam weights five areas: configuring products, configuring production prerequisites, implementing production methods, configuring production control, and implementing additional Supply Chain Management features. Topics named include product information management, costing, subcontracting, master planning, vendor rebates, service management, mixed reality and Copilot. Taking MB-330 first is recommended, with no formal prerequisite. The pass mark is 700, and the exam is offered in English and Japanese. A notice on the page says the exam was retired on 30 June 2026, while the scheduling section still reads no retirement date. The page gives no license details, price, duration or question format.

mb-700.title: Exam MB-700: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert – Microsoft Learn
mb-700.notes: MB-700 is part of the requirements for the Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert certification. It addresses professionals who advise stakeholders and turn business requirements into secure, scalable and reliable solutions, and who know the key architecture components of the finance and operations apps. The measured areas are architecting solutions, defining solution strategies, managing implementations and managing testing, with defining solution strategies carrying the largest weight. Expected knowledge covers the Dynamics 365 ecosystem and Power Platform, a deep understanding of the finance and operations apps, Copilot and AI agents in them, broad knowledge of at least one industry, and how individual decisions affect the overall solution. The pass mark is 700. The page names no formal prerequisites or license requirements. A personal Microsoft account is recommended for registration. According to a notice, the exam was retired on 30 June 2026, and it counts toward the certification only if taken before that date. No courses were listed as available.

mb-910.title: Exam MB-910: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (CRM) – Microsoft Learn
mb-910.notes: This beginner-level certification, aimed at the business owner role, confirms basic knowledge of the customer engagement capabilities of Dynamics 365. It suits people who want to learn how customer engagement apps can be used and who are starting with such solutions. It can help prepare for role-based or specialty certifications but is not required for any of them. The covered areas are Dynamics 365 Customer Insights for unifying profiles and designing personalized customer journeys, Sales for the sales order lifecycle, Customer Service for case handling across the support lifecycle, Field Service for planning and completing work orders, how Microsoft 365 Copilot can help in these areas, and core capabilities across the apps. The exam runs 45 minutes, is proctored and may contain interactive parts. A failed attempt can be retried after 24 hours. The page marks the certification as retired and links to an announcement. It gives no prerequisites, price, pass mark, license details or validity period.

mb-920.title: Exam MB-920: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (ERP) – Microsoft Learn
mb-920.notes: This beginner-level certification for the business owner role demonstrates foundational knowledge of the finance and operations capabilities of Dynamics 365. It targets people starting with Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management. The content covers how these solutions support an organization's financial model, represent business operations such as inventory and manufacturing, bring business processes together in one solution, manage several legal entities in one application and integrate with the Microsoft ecosystem. The exam sections are describing Supply Chain Management, describing Finance and describing the core capabilities of the finance and operations apps, with no weightings given. The exam takes 45 minutes, is proctored and can have interactive components. A failed attempt can be retried after 24 hours, and later waiting times vary. No training is offered for it, but a practice assessment and an exam sandbox exist. The certification can support role-based paths without being required. The page marks it as retired. It lists no prerequisites, licenses, cost, pass mark or validity.

outlook-web.title: Get to know Outlook on the web – Microsoft Support
outlook-web.notes: Outlook on the web is described as a browser-based way to keep email, calendar and contacts close at hand and to work together with other people. Messages can be sent and files shared, and the page mentions suggested replies and a like button to save time. A focused inbox prioritizes important messages. In the calendar, a meeting can be started by clicking a time slot, with further settings under more options, and smart time suggestions point to slots when all attendees are free. An appointment can be turned into a Teams meeting, and suggested locations are offered. A Microsoft 365 account can be connected to LinkedIn to exchange messages and files with contacts, and a search function covers mail, appointments and contacts. Typical uses are collaboration through email and file sharing, scheduling and organizing meetings. The page is an overview without step-by-step instructions and names no licenses, system requirements, plans or limitations.

dynamics-365-business-events.title: Business events overview – Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations – Microsoft Learn
dynamics-365-business-events.notes: Business events let external systems receive notifications from finance and operations apps so that business actions can be triggered in response. They arise while a business process runs, either from workflow actions such as approving a purchase requisition or from non-workflow actions such as confirming a purchase order. They are intended for integration and notification scenarios and are explicitly not a data export mechanism, because payloads are meant to stay small. Events can be consumed through Power Automate, Service Bus, Event Grid or other endpoint types, and customers need their own subscriptions for the Azure services. A business event catalog lists the available events with their data fields, and each activated event needs endpoints assigned. Events are inactive by default and can be activated globally or per legal entity. Failed deliveries are retried and then land in an error log, where they can be resent. A control number in the payload helps detect duplicates. Ordering is not guaranteed, and new events require developers to write extensions.

d365-data-entities.title: Data entities overview – Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations – Microsoft Learn
d365-data-entities.notes: A data entity abstracts the physical database tables and wraps a business concept in a de-normalized view, in which each row combines data from a main table and its related tables. A customer entity, for instance, merges several directory, customer and address tables. Data entities replace older concepts such as AXD, DIXF entities and aggregate queries with one concept that bundles business logic for import and export, integration and programmability. They also insulate application code from changes to physical tables between versions. Entities fall into five categories: parameter, reference, master, document and transaction. They can be exposed as OData services, for example for Office integration, or used asynchronously through the data management pipeline for file-based or recurring integrations. In application lifecycle scenarios they carry configuration data and support data migration. Each entity needs a unique label, and the entity list must be refreshed manually after code deployments or configuration key changes. The page lists no license requirements and notes that posted transactions are usually excluded or migrated only in summary form.

business-performance-analytics.title: What is Business performance analytics? – Dynamics 365 Finance – Microsoft Learn
business-performance-analytics.notes: Business performance analytics turns an organization's data into actionable insights and works with Dynamics 365, Dataverse and Power BI to analyze operational and financial data. Its purposes are consolidating key performance indicators, automating reporting and allowing custom analysis. It provides preconfigured reports and interactive dashboards for several business areas, plus dimensional data models usable in a SaaS or data-as-a-service approach. Custom models can be built on these models, for example in Microsoft Fabric, and data lake access uses shared Dataverse permissions. A preview ERP Analytics MCP server supports natural-language queries, DAX generation by AI agents and row-level security based on roles, and integrates with Visual Studio Code and Copilot Studio. The capability is included in the Dynamics 365 Finance license scope. Typical uses cover finance, supply chain, project operations and commerce reporting. Limits are reporting over a maximum of eight quarters, data volume bound by the Power BI Embedded A6 capacity and refreshes twice a day. Near real-time analysis and predictive insights are announced for later releases.

semantic-link-labs.title: microsoft/semantic-link-labs – GitHub
semantic-link-labs.notes: Semantic Link Labs is a Python library designed for use in Microsoft Fabric notebooks. It extends Semantic Link with additional functions that simplify technical processes and reduce manual work, and its source is a public repository under the MIT license. The functions cover semantic models, such as migration from import or DirectQuery to Direct Lake, Best Practice Analyzer, VertiPaq Analyzer, refresh and deployment between workspaces. For reports it offers best practice checks, listing broken visuals and rebinding to other semantic models. For capacities it supports migration from Premium or trial SKUs to Fabric and pausing or resuming capacities, and for lakehouses it offers table optimization, shortcut management and Delta Analyzer. It also wraps Power BI, Fabric, Azure and Microsoft Graph APIs and supports service principal authentication. Installation is done in a notebook with pip. Direct Lake migration requires XMLA read/write on the capacity. Calculated columns and auto date/time tables are not migrated, and calculated tables are only partly migrated. The project describes itself as early access to new features.
